versions.content: In post-build-selectable variant, E2EXf_Init() shall check that Config pointer (received as function parameter) points to one of the configuration variants E2EXf_ConfigStruct_<v>.If it is equal, then E2EXf_Init() shall select the passed configuration variant, and it shall set the module initialization state to TRUE according to SWS_E2EXf_00130.
